Introduction
This is a review of the industry performance, trends, and key developments for the first
quarter of 2026, starting January to March 2026. The report covers:
1. Domestic Highlights
2. Service Access and Subscriptions
3. Traffic and Usage
4. Financial Performance
5. Post and Courier Sector
6. Broadcast and Multimedia
7. Film and Cinema
